credentials_policy: caller must supply credential-free fixtures; helper rejects common credential flags and retains no environment/buffer payloads; arbitrary child stdout/stderr is not scrubbed
stderr_scope: target and tracer standard error combined
limits: Ptrace and counter polling perturb execution; no benchmark acceptance or direct disk latency.
Scheduler samples are cumulative observations, not exact CSwitch events.
strace follows owned target descendants; pid_or_tid is retained until lifecycle/observer identity resolves it.
Unseen short-lived threads and last-lifetime counters remain possible.
Separate EventPipe/native executions cannot be fused as exact causal overlaps.
target_executable_match_scope: sample may precede exec transition; raw owned execve record also retained

observer.scope: diagnostic sampled native OS counters only, never exact scheduler events or benchmark evidence
observer.initial_coverage: first successful snapshot; startup before it is not event-traced
observer.timing_clock: perf_counter_ns; legacy monotonic_ns is distinct and must not be joined to QPC
observer.flush_policy: flush each JSON line; no fsync/power-loss guarantee

capabilities.scheduler: per-thread cumulative schedstat and context-switch samples; not event trace
capabilities.schedstat_zero_policy: raw zero is not evidence of no wait; require supported/enabled counters
capabilities.io_scope: logical/syscall and accounted storage counters if supported, not file latency

native_summary.scope: ptrace-observed syscall intervals/counts, not physical disk latency or benchmark timing
native_summary.loss_status: strace supplies no kernel event-loss counter; incomplete/unparsed input retained
